sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The objective of this project is to stabilise the embankment at the site and reinstate the road to two lane conditions, without restrictions, to return the risk profile to road users at the site to normal conditions and mitigate safety risks.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The project scope includes the following works:
a) Provide works methodology, program, WHS and environmental plans for the works.
b) Mobilise to the site and establish safety and environmental controls. Remove vegetation from the slope and associated works area and scale the slope of loose soil and rocks.
c) Install rock bolting, horizontal drains, mesh and slope drainage as per design.
d) Install mass block wall (Design option 1).
e) Shotcrete slope down to mass block wall level (Design Option 1).
f) Shotcrete slope down to road level (Design Option 2).
g) Clean site and demobilisation.
Refer to the RFT documents for the comprehensive scope of works
